run_command: run a shell command with optional verbose logging and error checking via subprocess
get_repo_name: get the name of the current git repository by extracting the basename of the top-level directory
get_git_top_level: get the absolute path to the top-level directory of the current git repository
make_snapshot_shallow_git: create a shallow git snapshot of a repository at a specified snapshot root path
has_uncommitted_changes: check if the current git working directory has any uncommitted changes
